channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: US to get new NASA-led space academy, Trump signs order: What is it all about? Explained
item.description: The US Space Academy is a proposed NASA-led federal academy dedicated to combining rigorous technical education with leadership development, discipline, and a durable commitment to public service.

item.title: Nearly 2,500 Missing as Nepal, China Intensify Rescue Efforts
item.description: Nearly 2,500 people are missing following the flash floods that devastated a mountainous region between Nepal and China, with authorities on both sides of the border stepping up rescue efforts.

item.title: Bad news for CNG users in Delhi! Price hiked by ₹3.89 per kg: Check new rate here; know what led to the increase
item.description: Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL) has announced a hike in CNG prices in Delhi. Check new rates here.

item.title: Of advisor bots and fee cuts in the times of exec coaching wars
item.description: India's booming executive coaching industry is turning into a price war. New entrants are undercutting veterans to build hours and credentials, corporate clients are pushing for discounts, and AI looms as a cheaper alternative.

item.title: The week in charts: A decade of UPI, services inflation, Kanda Express
item.description: In this weekly Plain Facts compilation, we present to you data-based insights, with easy-to-read charts, to help you delve deeper into the stories reported by Mint in the week gone by.

item.title: Trump announces ‘biggest oil deal in history’ giving US majority control of 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan reserves
item.description: Donald Trump announced that the US has secured majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela’s proven oil reserves in what he calls the ‘biggest oil deal in history.’ He says the agreement will double US reserves, lower domestic gas prices, and boost Venezuela’s economy.

item.title: Iran war news LIVE: IRGC navy claims ‘decisive control’ over Hormuz; Trump announces ‘biggest oil deal in world history’
item.description: Iran war news LIVE: Iran’s IRGC reportedly rejected the US’s repeated claims that the Strait of Hormuz is open, saying US officials are continuing to “lie” about the status of the waterway to influence the price of oil and “cover up their failures.”

item.title: Apple TV hikes prices in US as streaming service gets more expensive
item.description: Apple is raising the price of its Apple TV streaming service in the US, with monthly and annual plans becoming more expensive immediately. The increase marks the fourth price hike since the service launched in 2019.

item.title: Dolly Parton airport? Tennessee governor backs fans’ push to rename Nashville airport after country music icon
item.description: A campaign to rename Nashville International Airport after Dolly Parton has gained support from Tennessee Governor Bill Lee and the airport authority's CEO, just days after the country music icon's death at 80.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump administration targets Egyptian bank’s UAE branches in fresh push to isolate Iran
item.description: The Trump administration has moved to restrict Banque Misr's UAE branches from the US financial system. They have accused the bank of supporting Iran, as Washington intensifies its push to economically isolate Tehran and pressure countries to cut financial ties.&nbsp;

item.title: Big change for packaged foods? India proposes front-pack warnings for high sugar, salt and fat, says report
item.description: The FSSAI proposed a red hexagonal label for foods high in saturated fat, sugar, and salt to promote consumer awareness. Despite government efforts, companies resisted warning labels, leading to public outcry for clearer food labeling in India.

item.title: NCLT case coverage: Reliance rejects Subhash Chandra’s allegations against its media entities as ‘baseless’
item.description: Reliance Group says it&nbsp;strongly denies the allegations and insinuations against its media entities, which have never been used to attack anyone.

item.title: Mumbai milk price hike: How much prices rose, why, and how other metros compare
item.description: Mumbai's tabela milk price will rise by ₹9 to ₹102 a litre from 1 September, with producers citing higher cattle and feed costs. The increase will remain is effect until 28 February 2027 and comes ahead of the festive season.&nbsp;

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe-led Maharashtra FDA cancels Cipla unit's drug licence over Reactin Plus irregularities
item.description: FDA cancels Cipla unit's drug licence: During an inspection in June, FDA officials found that the packaging of Reactin Plus Tablets, a Schedule H prescription medicine, carried an unauthorised claim describing it as an analgesic and antipyretic.

item.title: B Nagendra resigns from Karnataka Cabinet 25 days after re-induction
item.description: Karnataka Planning Minister B Nagendra resigned amid allegations connected to the Valmiki Corporation scam, just 25 days after his return to the Cabinet. Nagendra said he had formally handed over his resignation to Shivakumar.

item.title: Iran urges nations not to yield to US threats as it keeps door open to diplomacy
item.description: Iran urged other countries not to give in to US threats as Washington intensified economic pressure on Tehran. The Iranian foreign minister also said resuming diplomacy remained possible if the US abandoned its reliance on coercion.&nbsp;

item.title: India, Canada target C$70 billion bilateral trade by 2030, eye investment treaty talks
item.description: India is ready to begin negotiations on a bilateral investment treaty, while the two countries seek deeper cooperation in finance, payments, fintech and critical minerals.

item.title: PM Modi remembers King Harald V's 'warmth', offers condolences to Norway
item.description: Crown Prince Haakon, 53, became King Haakon VIII when his father, Harald V, died Friday.

item.title: Javelin anti-tank system: What are its features? Key details of India’s plan to sign $45.7 million deal with US
item.description: India plans to acquire the US-made Javelin anti-tank missile system for $45.7 million, enhancing defence ties with the US. The deal may lead to joint manufacturing, reflecting ‘record-level’ engagement between the two nations, according to US Ambassador Sergio Gor.

item.title: After 200+ applications, laid-off corporate worker takes ₹1,049 dishwashing job: 'Not doing for money'
item.description: The man said he was dismissed in April and received what he described as a 'nice' nine-month severance package.

item.title: Nepal flash floods: Death toll hits 538, 977 people still missing including 320 Indians confirms govt
item.description: Nepal flash floods: The death toll from Nepal's devastating flash flood in the Bhotekoshi River area has risen to 538, out of which the largest number has been recorded in the Chitwan. At least 400 Indian nationals were stranded in Nepal.

item.title: Explained | Sugar prices are rising sharply — this is what is driving the sudden spike
item.description: Sugar prices have skyrocketed in the market. In a bid to ease prices, the Centre has permitted imports of 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar until 31 October.&nbsp;

item.title: ₹300 bribe: Why did Jharkhand High Court grant clemency to accused in 1993 corruption case
item.description: The Jharkhand High Court reduced a man's sentence in a 1993 corruption case involving a ₹300 demand after considering his three-decade trial and the minor amount.

item.title: PM Narendra Modi shares glimpses of Rakshabandhan as he celebrates with young students. See pics
item.description: Students were seen tying rakhis on PM Narendra Modi's wrist in pictures from the Rakshabandhan celebration. The PM shook hands and even gave them a high-five.

item.title: Row explained | Why Bangladesh is bullish on China's J-10 fighters, not Dassault Rafale
item.description: Rafael vs J10: Bangladesh is moving ahead with plans to buy China’s J-10CE fighters, citing lower costs, modern capabilities and reported combat performance. India, however, does not confirm losing Rafales to J-10s, making the claim a key point of debate.

item.title: Centre plans new financing framework to unlock ₹150 trillion investment pipeline
item.description: The framework seeks to build a pipeline of bankable projects and deepen debt markets as India faces an estimated ₹85 trillion external funding need for FY27-31.

item.title: Flash flood warning in Nepal after 5.1-magnitude earthquake hits China; evacuation near Trishuli
item.description: The 5.1-magnitude earthquake was recorded in Longchang City in Sichuan Province, southwestern China, the China Earthquake Networks Centre said.

item.title: Who is Sukumara Kurup? Here is why Keralam’s most infamous fugitive is back in the news after four decades
item.description: Keralam Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala has directed the Crime Branch to verify reports about fugitive Sukumara Kurup being alive. There are rumours he lives under a false identity in a foreign country, but Chennithala emphasized the need for factual investigation over speculation.

item.title: Nepal floods top updates: At least 469 dead, over 1,000 missing as China halts rescue ops amid risk of renewed flooding
item.description: Catastrophic floods in Nepal have killed at least 469 people, with more than 1,000 missing. Rescue efforts remain challenging amid fears of further flooding, a swelling lake near the Nepal-China border and heavy rainfall forecasts, while authorities continue evacuations and search operations.

item.title: Nepal flash floods: Why Kathmandu declined foreign rescue teams and what were lessons from 2015 earthquake
item.description: Nepal flash floods: The Nepal government has received multiple official and unofficial requests from countries and organisations to send their own search-and-rescue teams, Kathmandu Post said, quoting a senior foreign ministry official.

item.title: Anthropic vs Pentagon: Judge rules in favour of AI company, says US govt acted ‘illegally’; all you need to know
item.description: A US judge has ruled in favour of AI company Anthropic in its legal battle with the Pentagon, finding that the government's actions against the company were illegal. The ruling comes after Anthropic challenged its designation as a supply chain risk.

item.title: Raksha Bandhan 2026: President Droupadi Murmu, PM Narendra Modi extend ‘heartfelt greetings’, celebrate its significance
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu and PM Narendra Modi extended heartfelt greetings on Raksha Bandhan. Droupadi Murmu underscored the festival's cultural significance, emphasizing the bonds of protection and mutual responsibility.

item.title: Worried you might not be able to see the partial lunar eclipse? Here's a list of YouTube channels offering livestreams
item.description: A partial lunar eclipse will darken around 96 per cent of the Moon on 28 August, with the event mainly visible across North and South America. Skywatchers elsewhere can catch the celestial spectacle through livestreams from observatories and astronomy platforms.

item.title: New York, Huntsville, Palm Desert: Which Red Lobster locations are closing in 2026? See complete list
item.description: In June, Red Lobster shuttered its Times Square restaurant after 23 years, leaving Manhattan without a single Red Lobster location. Here's the full list of Red Lobster locations getting shut down in 2026.

item.title: White House construction may have contributed to Trump's Marine One getting close to commercial jet - What we know
item.description: NTSB reported that ongoing White House construction contributed to radio communication issues, leading to a near-collision. Problems arose due to inadequate line-of-sight and relocation of Marine One during construction, prompting FAA action to improve communications.
